subject: How to check identical and non-identical SNP between individuals from identity by descent (IBD) results using gl.grm()

messages.author: e128ae1057d75fd3
messages.subject: How to check identical and non-identical SNP between individuals from identity by descent (IBD) results using gl.grm()
parts:
Hi,

Is there a way to determine which SNPs are identical and which are not identical among the individuals tested using identity by descent (IBD) based on the function gl.grm()? And how many SNPs match/mismatches? From my understanding, values ranging from 0 to positive (+) indicate increasing the similarity between the tested individuals in matrix heatmap. If that’s the case, we should be able to check which SNPs are identical and which are not within the combination matrix of individuals. The reason I would like to know which SNPs are identical and which are not between individuals based on the genomic relationship matrix originating from the question of whether two or more individuals are the true parent-offspring pairs or not. I would like to check how many and which SNPs are mismatched. I believe that the number of mismatched SNPs should be reflected in the IBD (Identity By Descent) values, with more mismatches leading to a lower IBD value (approaching negative).

I greatly appreciate your response.

Regards,

Rizki

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: How to check identical and non-identical SNP between individuals from identity by descent (IBD) results using gl.grm()
parts:
Hi Rizki,

To test if a pair of individuals are true parent-offspring, you can use our updated functions gl.report.parent.offspring and gl.filter.parent.offspring which you can install using:

devtools::install_github("green-striped-gecko/dartR.captive@dev")

These functions examine the frequency of pedigree inconsistent loci, that is, those loci that are homozygotes in the parent for the reference allele, and homozygous in the offspring for the alternate allele (and viceversa).

To check which loci are inconsistent with a parent-offspring relationship in a pair of individuals, you can use the code below:

library(dartRverse)
x <- platypus.gl
r1 <- gl.report.parent.offspring(x,
                                 min.rdepth = 12,
                                 min.reproducibility = 1,
                                 range = 2)
r1
# The first pair of individuals that had only one incompatible locus
ind_to_test <- unlist(unname(r1[3,c("ind1","ind2")]))
# subsetting individuals
ind_to_test2 <- which(indNames(x)%in%ind_to_test)
test_mat <- t(as.data.frame(as.matrix(x)[ind_to_test2,]))
# testing which loci are incompatible with a parent-offspring relationship
# ie homozygotes for the reference allele in one individual and
# homozygotesfor the alternate allele in the other individuals (and viceversa).
test1 <- unname(which(test_mat[,1] == 0 & test_mat[,2] == 2))
test2 <- unname(which(test_mat[,1] == 2 & test_mat[,2] == 0))
# subsetting incompatible loci
mismatch <- test_mat[c(test1,test2),]
# Note that there are more incompatible loci here because the function
# gl.report.parent.offspring filters on read depth and reproducibility
mismatch

Cheers,
Luis
